# sqlpipe v2.0 release notes

## Breaking changes

The `/v2/users` endpoint changed the response format. Version 1 returned one `name` field. Version 2 returns two fields: `first_name` and `last_name`.

If your code reads `name`, you must update it before you upgrade. Read `first_name` and `last_name` instead.

## New features

Version 2.0 adds the `--incremental` flag. If you set `--incremental`, sqlpipe copies only the rows that changed since the last run.

## Performance

Version 2.0 writes Parquet files 40% faster than version 1.9.

## How to upgrade

1. Update your client code to read `first_name` and `last_name`.
2. Install sqlpipe v2.0.
3. Run your pipeline.
